title: 69 Construction Fails That Make You Wonder Who Looked At Them And Said "Good Enough"
text: 69 Construction Fails That Make You Wonder Who Looked At Them And Said “Good Enough” No one wants to even think about bad construction workers. They make buildings and put electrical wires on the street and well, they're responsible for a lot. So while it may be scary to think of them not doing their work properly, it can also be pretty funny. The full list of construction fails is in the article. Have you ever walked down a street and noticed something that felt a little off? Maybe a water pipe that looked like it was about to break, or electrical wires hanging loose right out in the open. And you might think, “This is giving Soviet infrastructure. ” Well, if you have, you’re not alone. Sometimes, things just aren’t built the way they should be, which shows how important it is for architects, engineers, and construction workers to work together. And some people ondecided to share some of the construction fails they’ve spotted out in the wild, and here’s what they found.Some of the entries on this list are wild, to say the least. And surely, you’ve spotted some questionable construction fails yourself, like a streetlight in the middle of a driveway or a door that opens into a wall. This is because subcontractors are legally obligated to follow the blueprints as they’re drawn. So, even if a toilet blocks a door or a tree is placed in the middle of a parking space, unfortunately, that’s how it gets built according to the blueprint.
